findings.excerpt:
theorem directionalDerivative_mem_coefficientSubmodule (V : Submodule ℚ L)
    (h : σ → ℚ) (P : VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L)
    (hP : ∀ α, coefficients P α ∈ V) :
    ∀ α, coefficients (directionalDerivative h P) α ∈ V := by
  intro α
  rw [coefficients_directionalDerivative]
findings.problem: The lemma is stated only for ℚ coefficients and under the section's `[LieRing L] [LieAlgebra ℚ L]`, although its statement and proof use nothing but the ℚ-module structure of L: `coefficients` is a linear equivalence and `directionalDerivative h` is a finite sum of `(MvPolynomial.pderiv i).toLinearMap.rTensor L`, which is defined for any commutative coefficient ring and any module. The repository already defines `VectorPolynomial σ R V` for arbitrary `[CommRing R] [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V]` and `coefficientSubmodule` for arbitrary K, and it uses real-coefficient vector polynomials in many places (e.g. `VectorPolynomial I ℝ (J → ℝ)`), so this ℚ/Lie-restricted form cannot be reused there. The restriction is only inherited from the definition `directionalDerivative` in RealPolynomialChartSubstitution.lean:62 and from `coefficients_directionalDerivative` in ShiftedGradedCalculus.lean:166, not from the mathematics.
findings.proposed_change:
Generalize `directionalDerivative` to
  `noncomputable def directionalDerivative {σ R V : Type*} [Fintype σ] [CommRing R]
      [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] (h : σ → R) :
      VectorPolynomial σ R V →ₗ[R] VectorPolynomial σ R V := ∑ i, h i • (MvPolynomial.pderiv i).toLinearMap.rTensor V`,
and likewise state `coefficients_directionalDerivative` over R (its proof is the same: `LinearMap.rTensor_tmul`, `coefficients_tmul`, `MvPolynomial.coeff_pderiv`, `smul_smul`, `Finset.sum`). Then state the target lemma as
  `theorem directionalDerivative_mem_coefficientSubmodule {σ R V : Type*} [Fintype σ] [CommRing R]
      [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] (W : Submodule R V) (h : σ → R)
      (P : VectorPolynomial σ R V) (hP : ∀ α, coefficients P α ∈ W) :
      ∀ α, coefficients (directionalDerivative h P) α ∈ W`
with exactly the existing proof body (`intro α; rw [coefficients_directionalDerivative]; exact W.sum_mem (fun i _ => W.smul_mem _ (W.smul_mem _ (hP _)))`). If a general definition is deemed out of scope, at least restate it with `[AddCommGroup L] [Module ℚ L]`, which requires relaxing the instance arguments of `directionalDerivative` in RealPolynomialChartSubstitution.lean:62 (unverified by compilation). Degenerate case: for empty σ the sum is empty, so the conclusion is `0 ∈ W`, which holds by `Submodule.zero_mem`.
findings.benefit: Users get a statement about arbitrary coefficient rings and plain modules, usable with the real-coefficient `VectorPolynomial σ ℝ (...)` objects that appear throughout the development, and consistent with the already-general `VectorPolynomial`/`coefficientSubmodule` API. The original ℚ case is recovered by specialization, so nothing is lost.

abbrev VectorPolynomial (σ R V : Type*) [CommRing R] [AddCommGroup V] [Module R V] :=
  MvPolynomial σ R ⊗[R] V

noncomputable def coefficientSubmodule (U : Submodule K L) : Submodule K (VectorPolynomial σ K L) where
  carrier := {p | ∀ α, coefficients p α ∈ U}

noncomputable def directionalDerivative [Fintype σ] (h : σ → ℚ) :
    VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L →ₗ[ℚ] VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L :=
  ∑ i, h i • (MvPolynomial.pderiv i).toLinearMap.rTensor L

theorem coefficients_directionalDerivative [Fintype σ]
    (h : σ → ℚ) (p : VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L) (α : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    coefficients (directionalDerivative h p) α =
      ∑ i, h i • ((α i + 1 : ℚ) • coefficients p (α + Finsupp.single i 1))

findings.problem: The coefficientwise hypotheses `hAU`/`hAV` are stronger than what the proof consumes. Applying `dualLogDerivative_mem_of_invariant` needs only `dualBaseLinear (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A).coord ∈ U` and `dualTangentLinear (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A).coord ∈ V`, and by `dualEvalLie_base`/`dualEvalLie_tangent` these are exactly `eval t A.coord ∈ U` and `eval t (directionalDerivative h A.coord) ∈ V`. The present proof discards all coefficient information except at the single point t via `(eval_mem_iff_coefficients U.toSubmodule A.coord).mpr hAU t` (lines 40 and 43-44). The same stronger-than-needed coefficientwise pattern is repeated for A and C at lines 76-77, 84-101 of `polynomial_removal_preserves_derivative_layers`, which internally only needs `dualBaseLinear`/`dualTangentLinear` memberships of the first jets (DualDerivativeRemoval.lean:135-144).
findings.proposed_change:
Add (and use as the primary form) the strictly weaker-hypothesis statement
  `theorem polynomialLogDerivative_mem_of_eval (t h : σ → ℚ) (U : LieSubalgebra ℚ L)
      (V : Submodule ℚ L) (hUV : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ V, ⁅u, v⁆ ∈ V)
      (A : PolynomialGroup σ hnil) (hAU : eval t A.coord ∈ U)
      (hAV : eval t (directionalDerivative h A.coord) ∈ V) :
      polynomialLogDerivative t h A ∈ V`,
proved by `apply dualLogDerivative_mem_of_invariant U V hUV (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A)` followed by `rw [dualEvalLie_base]` (resp. `rw [dualEvalLie_tangent]`) and the hypothesis, with `polynomialLogDerivative` definitionally `dualLogDerivative (polynomialFirstJetHom t h A)`. Keep the current coefficientwise statement as a corollary, deriving `eval t A.coord ∈ U` from `hAU` via `eval_mem_iff_coefficients` and `eval t (directionalDerivative h A.coord) ∈ V` from `hAV` via `directionalDerivative_mem_coefficientSubmodule` and `eval_mem_iff_coefficients` (the existing proof steps). The same pointwise hypotheses should be offered for `polynomial_removal_preserves_derivative_layers`. For empty σ these evaluations are still well defined (the empty function is the unique `σ → ℚ`), and the statement reduces to the base cases of `dualLogDerivative_mem_of_invariant`.
findings.benefit: Callers that know only the first-jet data at the point t (the form in which tangent hypotheses already appear elsewhere, e.g. `(MvPolynomial.pderiv i).toLinearMap.rTensor L P.coord ∈ V`) can apply the result without proving coefficientwise membership for every multi-index, while the structural coefficientwise version remains available unchanged.

theorem dualEvalLie_base (t h : σ → ℚ) (p : VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L) :
    dualBaseLinear (dualEvalLie t h p) = eval t p

theorem dualEvalLie_tangent [Fintype σ] (t h : σ → ℚ) (p : VectorPolynomial σ ℚ L) :
    dualTangentLinear (dualEvalLie t h p) = eval t (directionalDerivative h p)

noncomputable def polynomialLogDerivative (t h : σ → ℚ) (P : PolynomialGroup σ hnil) : L :=
  dualLogDerivative (polynomialFirstJetHom t h P)

theorem dualLogDerivative_mem_of_invariant (U : LieSubalgebra ℚ L) (V : Submodule ℚ L)
    (hUV : ∀ u ∈ U, ∀ v ∈ V, ⁅u, v⁆ ∈ V) (z : DualGroup hnil)
    (hb : dualBaseLinear z.coord ∈ U) (ht : dualTangentLinear z.coord ∈ V) :
    dualLogDerivative z ∈ V

theorem eval_mem_iff_coefficients (U : Submodule K V) (p : VectorPolynomial σ K V) :
    (∀ x : σ → K, eval x p ∈ U) ↔ ∀ α, coefficients p α ∈ U
